caption: Sint-Nicolaaskerk, Dwingeloo
composition: Brick village church with an onion spire on the brink · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Nicolaaskerk stands on the brink at Dwingeloo. The brick tower carries the onion spire called the Siepel, not a needle, beside a single-aisle Gothic nave. The church is closed. It is overcast, about 8.6°C, with wind near 4.0 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The heath and the telescope are other scenes and are not in this frame.
